# Planet Natural

> > Planet Natural is a comprehensive organic gardening resource providing expert guides on plant care, tree cultivation, sustainable landscaping, and natural pest management.

Founded by gardening experts including Eric Vinje, Planet Natural offers detailed planting guides and care instructions for trees, flowers, houseplants, and vegetables. The site emphasizes organic gardening practices, pollinator-friendly plants, and drought-tolerant landscaping solutions for gardeners across USDA zones in North America and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Planting guides
- Drought-tolerant plants
- Houseplant care
- Tree care and varieties
- Deciduous trees
- Pollinator plants
- Landscape gardening
- Indoor gardening
- Shade trees
- Organic pest control
- USDA hardiness zones
- Dutch elm disease resistance
- Perennial flowers
- Native plants
- Sustainable landscaping

## Tree Care and Varieties

- [Elm Tree Guide: 10 Popular Types of Elm Trees in 2024](https://www.planetnatural.com/elm-tree): Guide to 10 elm tree types including Dutch elm disease resistant varieties
- [16 Incredible Maple Tree Species to Consider Growing](https://www.planetnatural.com/maple-tree): Guide to 16 Acer maple species for shade and autumn foliage display
- [How to Plant, Grow, and Care for Dogwood Tree Easily](https://www.planetnatural.com/dogwood-tree-2): Planting guide for Cornus Florida ornamental trees with stunning blooms
- [Larch Trees 101: Facts and Care Tips for Healthy Growth](https://www.planetnatural.com/larch): Larix tree care guide covering deciduous conifer growth and maintenance
- [Poplar Tree Guide: 10 Most Popular Types of Poplar Trees](https://www.planetnatural.com/poplar-tree): Guide to 10 Populus species including fast-growing shade trees
- [How to Plant, Grow, and Care for Jacaranda Tree Easily | Planet Natural](https://www.planetnatural.com/jacaranda-tree): Jacaranda mimosifolia planting guide for purple-flowering shade trees

## Flower Growing Guides

- [Complete Guide to Plant, Grow, and Care for Sunflowers](https://www.planetnatural.com/sunflowers): Helianthus annuus planting guide for pollinator-friendly annual flowers
- [Peonies: How to Plant, Grow, and Care for Peony Flowers](https://www.planetnatural.com/growing-peonies): Paeonia planting and care guide for showy spring perennial flowers
- [How to Plant, Grow, and Care for Blanket Flower (Gaillardia)](https://www.planetnatural.com/blanket-flower): Growing guide for Gaillardia aristata, drought-tolerant pollinator plant
- [How To Plant And Grow Moonflower (Full Step-by-Step Guide)](https://www.planetnatural.com/moonflower): Step-by-step guide for growing Ipomoea alba night-blooming vines
- [How to Plant, Grow, and Care for Snowdrop Flower (Galanthus)](https://www.planetnatural.com/snowdrop-flower): Galanthus nivalis bulb planting guide for early spring blooms

## Houseplant Care

- [How to Grow & Care for Monstera Adansonii | Swiss Cheese Plant](https://www.planetnatural.com/monstera-adansonii): Care guide for Monstera adansonii tropical vine houseplant
- [How to Plant, Grow, and Care for China Doll Plant - Full Guide](https://www.planetnatural.com/china-doll-plant): Care guide for Radermachera sinica, low-maintenance houseplant
- [How to Plant, Grow, and Care for Pearls and Jade Pothos in 2023](https://www.planetnatural.com/pearls-and-jade-pothos): Care guide for variegated Pearls and Jade pothos houseplant variety

## Shrubs and Drought-Tolerant Plants

- [Oleander Guide: How to Grow and Care for Nerium Oleander](https://www.planetnatural.com/oleander): Nerium oleander care guide for toxic yet beautiful flowering shrubs
- [How to Plant, Grow, and Care for Stonecrop (Sedum)](https://www.planetnatural.com/stonecrop): Low-maintenance Sedum growing guide for drought-tolerant rock gardens

## Vegetable Gardening

- [How to Grow Pumpkins: Pumpkin Planting and Harvesting Guide](https://www.planetnatural.com/how-to-grow-pumpkins): Complete pumpkin growing guide from planting to Halloween harvest

## Landscape Design and Seasonal Care

- [Revolutionize Your Yard: 12 Grass-Free Landscaping Trends](https://www.planetnatural.com/grass-free-landscaping-ideas): 12 innovative lawn alternatives and grass-free yard design trends
- [11 Secrets to a Hydrated and Happy Christmas Tree](https://www.planetnatural.com/christmas-tree-care): Holiday tree hydration and maintenance tips for fresh Christmas trees

## Optional

- [Centipede: Complete Guide to Centipedes (Inside and Outside)](https://www.planetnatural.com/centipede): Chilopoda arthropod guide covering habits, habitat, and pest control
